title: Kevin Egan
html_source:
Fenian friend of Stephen. Exiled in Paris.

PROPOSED SUGGESTION: Father of Patrice

anchor.prefix:
eth chaussons of pastry, their mouths yellowed with the pus of flan breton. Faces of Paris men go by, their wellpleased pleasers, curled conquistadores. 

1922#42

 Noon slumbers.
anchor.suffix: rolls gunpowder cigarettes through fingers smeared with printer's ink, sipping his green fairy as Patrice his white. About us gobblers fork spiced beans down their gullets. Un dem
